test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is Vindhya Range **NOT **located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

__
 
• **Vindhya range is not located in Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vindhyan Range**

 
 
• This range acts as a water divide between the Ganga system and the river system of south India.
 
• It is located in the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Southern parts of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar**__.
 
• **Sad-bhawna Shikhar** is the highest peak of this range.
 
• It is not located in Rajasthan.
